title: Store Update 1.31.0
body:
# Store Update 1.31.0

Hello Raiders!

Today's update is a Store Update, bringing the new Sheath Set into the game. No restart is required, you can find it in the game right now.

A new week also means new offers from Ermal, going live at 6:00 AM PDT / 1:00 PM UTC / 3:00 PM CEST.

Thanks to everyone who keeps sending in reports about current bugs and issues. Work and investigation continues into the crashes, performance problems, and connection issues that some players are experiencing.

Catch you Topside, //Raz
